path.description: Base directory for storing downloaded websites. Supports ~ for home directory.

filter_rules.description: List of filter rules to control which files are downloaded. Each item is a string like '+html[/]' or '-jpg'. If empty, uses default broad filter.

depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for following links. 0 for unlimited.

mirror.description: Whether to enable mirror mode (recursive downloading).

keep_alive.description: Whether to use HTTP keep-alive connections.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to identify this downloader to web servers.

max_retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed request.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for network connections.
